what: fireteam_defend_v12's own checkpoints, re-scored under the v1.13 ENDEX close rule (16cb2a6). The policy learned under the old rule, where the root could declare MISSION COMPLETE; this is the bar an ENDEX-era retrain has to beat, and it is a property of a CHECKPOINT, not of a run.
why_committed: refs #24. The figure first published for this baseline was a bare 0.22 with no checkpoint and no N, and it matches neither checkpoint measured here. A number the boards print has to be re-readable from disk like every other number on them.
note: ckpt_latest.pt is gitignored, so the latest-checkpoint row is reproducible only where the run still lives on disk; sha256 (refs #28) at least lets a re-measurement prove it scored the same weights. behavior.json / behavior_final.json in this directory are the OLD-rule evaluations and are left untouched.
